_note: The after-fight pick's upgrades (docs/plans/upgrade-pools.md; built in phase 5c step 7, docs/plans/rebuild-phase5c-combos.md, section 15). Three layers: a hero's own cards ("hero"), always offered; a path's taste cards ("path" with "taste": true), offered while vowed to it until the hero transforms, and carried on after with their "transformed_mod" (Decision 35); and a path's cards ("path"), offered once transformed. Each is a kit modifier (KitMod) on the hero's slots; a stacking card ("stacks") locks in a share of the hero's stat when taken and can be taken again; a growing card ("grows") grows all run. The pick never offers a card that changes nothing on the hero's kit now (Decision 37). Numbers are placeholders.

name: Ringing Mark
text: His Marks also Slow.

name: Quick Knell
text: Death Knell costs less mana.

name: Heavy Toll
text: Toll deals more damage to Marked enemies.

passives.name: Heavy Toll
passives.text: His Toll deals more damage to Marked enemies.

name: Bell Metal
text: Every name the bell calls hardens its metal: Marked enemies take more damage from his team for the rest of the run.

passives.name: Bell Metal
passives.text: Grows with his Marks: his team deals more damage to Marked enemies.

name: Layered Plate
text: Each layer makes his Shield grow faster.

name: Plate on Plate
text: While his Shield is bigger than his max HP, he takes less damage.

passives.name: Plate on Plate
passives.text: While his Shield is bigger than his max HP, he takes less damage.

name: Echoing Burst
text: Each enemy a Burst hits makes later Bursts stronger still.

name: Aftershock
text: His Bursts Stun what they hit for a moment.

name: Meat Grinder
text: Each enemy that dies beside him feeds the Grinder more.

name: Barbed Ring
text: His Grinder also makes the enemies beside him Bleed.

name: Deep Current
text: Each enemy his chains drag beside him gives him more ATK and DEF.

passives.name: Deep Current
passives.text: Each enemy his chains drag beside him gives him more ATK and DEF for the rest of the fight.

name: Drowning Depths
text: Enemies he pulls are Slowed.

passives.name: Drowning Depths
passives.text: Enemies he pulls are Slowed.

name: Crown of Thorns
text: Each 250 he sends back makes it grow faster.

name: Barbed Hide
text: What he sends back makes its target Bleed.

passives.name: Barbed Hide
passives.text: What he sends back makes the enemy it hits Bleed.

name: Wrath
text: What he stores grows faster.

name: Patient Fury
text: His Vengeance's blast heals him for a share of its damage.

passives.name: Patient Fury
passives.text: His Vengeance's blast heals him for a share of its damage.

name: Deeper Dark
text: Each attack from Stealth gives her more ATK still.

name: Smoke Trail
text: When she leaves Stealth, the enemies next to her are Slowed.

passives.name: Smoke Trail
passives.text: When her Stealth ends, the enemies within 1 hex of her are Slowed.

name: Shadow Pact
text: Each time she hides her allies, every hero attacks faster still.

name: Long Shadows
text: Her allies stay hidden longer.

name: Bloodied Axe
text: Each kill by Sentence gives her more ATK still.

name: Hanging Judge
text: An execution Marks the enemies near the fallen.

passives.name: Hanging Judge
passives.text: When Sentence finishes an enemy, the enemies within 2 hexes of it are Marked.

name: Relentless
text: Each kill makes her damage higher still.

name: Open Veins
text: Each step makes the enemy she steps to Bleed.

name: Tightening Cord
text: Each tick of her Garrote makes the next ones harder still.

name: Silent Grip
text: An enemy she Garrotes is Silenced.

name: Iron Grip
text: Her rally on held enemies gives every hero more ATK and MGK still.

name: Pinning Knives
text: Her hits on a held enemy also Root an enemy next to it.

passives.name: Pinning Knives
passives.text: Her hits on a Rooted or Stunned enemy Root the enemy nearest it within 1 hex for a moment.

name: Rising Chorus
text: Each signature gives every hero more mana.

name: Encore
text: Crescendo gives him back some mana.

name: Deep Reservoir
text: Each signature from past full makes Chorus's share grow more.

name: Overflowing Start
text: Every hero starts each fight with a full bar and 20 mana past it.

passives.name: Overflowing Start
passives.text: As the fight starts, every hero's bar fills and runs 20 mana past full.

name: Far Wind
text: Each kill from afar gives the ranged heroes more damage still.

name: Clear Air
text: Ranged heroes' hits ignore some of the target's DEF.

passives.name: Clear Air
passives.text: Ranged allies' hits ignore some of the target's DEF.

passives.name: Clear Air
passives.text: His own too.

name: Rising Pitch
text: Each carried Toll makes the next on that enemy stronger still.

name: Ringing Arrows
text: Carried Tolls Slow their target for a moment.

name: Deep Bronze
text: Each Death Knell makes every hero's damage grow more.

name: Ringing Ears
text: Death Knell Slows every enemy it Marks.

name: Dirge
text: Each toll makes the later ones stronger still.

name: Silent Toll
text: His tolls Silence the enemies they hit.
